strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Nadesico is destroyed
And so, we're escaping Earth!
Hmmm...
Prospector? What's wrong? We made it this far safely.
(This is going far too smoothly...
It seems Jaburo truly isn't functioning...)
Prospector? That's weird.
Captain, what do we do now?
Just as planned, we head for Mars!
The people at the Mars colonies are waiting for us!
(Mars... where I was born...)
Before that! We must head to Satsuki Midori Colony.
Oh, right... We're picking up supplies there, aren't we?
But Satsuki Midori Colony... isn't it...
Currently out of contact. ...Maybe...
We'll just have to find out.
Hmm, the space frames for the Aestivalis, plus their pilots...
We can hardly just leave them there.
So Satsuki Midori Colony comes before Mars. Got it~
Isn't there something we gotta do first?
Ah, that... right.
Oh, that? Like we decided, let's just smash it and get going!
Captain! We decided no such thing! We enter the release code!
Boson reaction.
What!? An enemy attack...!?
The Jovian Lizards...!
All riiight! I'm launching!
Huh? Gai!?
That was fast!
You bet it was!
I heard we were smashing the barrier, so I was waiting on the deck!
Last time that punk Tenkawa stole the spotlight from me!
Oh dear, it seems he's forgotten about the release code as well...
C'mon! Bring it on, you lizards!
Yamada! Don't you go outside the gravity wave beam!
Okay, okaaay! Just leave it to me!
...Think he gets it?
Probably the same thing you're thinking, Megumi.
Tenkawa?
I... really gotta go out there...?
Akito, our lives are... all in your hands now!
Take out the lizards and the barrier, all at once!
Not the barrier, Tenkawa!
Huh...
Tenkawa, please take care of it, then.
Guess I've got no choice...
What's the deal, Tenkawa!? Just leave this to me already!
No can do! Not the barrier yet, Gai!
Hoshino, enter the code, please.
Roger.
Tenkawa, Yamada, hacking the Barrier Satellite will take 3 minutes.
Please hold out until then.
It's Daigouji! All right, here I go!
Make it quick, Yurika!
Entering release code.
1. Who owns the blue Earth? 2. Who owns the green Earth?
WHO OWNS THE BLUE EARTH?
Whew, we didn't have to destroy the barrier after all... Phew.
All right! Code entry successful! Akitooo! You can smash it now!
Captain! Were you even listening!?
WHO OWNS THE GREEN EARTH?
No good.
No way! The wrong code...!?
No need to panic, Prospector! Okay, Akito! Yamada!
Go ahead and smash it!
I've been waiting for this! Time to wreck it!
Hey, are you really sure about this!? Yurika!
Yup! That's what you went out there for!
Haaah...
Well, I kinda saw that coming~
Tenkawa, Yamada, please destroy the satellite. Spectacularly.
Well, that settles the barrier.
Now, let's shake them off quickly and head for Satsuki Midori Colony...
That's all fine, but something's coming, you know?
Huh?
So that's... the Nadesico!?
It would seem so. ...And the Barrier Satellite already looks disabled.
Quite efficient of them.
That's... the Federation's Ra Cailum...! Which means...
The Nadesico... Now, what to do?
Why not just wreck its engines and stop it?
Quite the roughneck, aren't you, Maria?
But... if I remember right, the Nadesico's captain is...
Hiii! I'm the captain!
V for victory, take two!
Huh?
...What's the meaning of this?
Deceiving us would gain them nothing.
Yurika! This is the same thing that happened on Earth!
No, the Admiral's daughter is 20... She'd be about that age.
...Captain Misumaru, your father, Admiral Misumaru, told me about you.
We have no intention of being your enemy.
Huh... From Father? Oh no, he didn't say anything weird, did he?
Geez! He's always telling everyone stories about when I was little~
No, nothing like that...
Hm, Captain Bright seems... to be having a hard time.
That girl's quite the skilled player.
...At what?
Um, this conversation's getting tangled.
Yurika!
It can't be helped.
...Ahem. Well, to the Federation's independent unit, Londo Bell,
captain of the flagship Ra Cailum, Colonel Bright Noa:
I am the auditor for Nergal Heavy Industries. My name is Prospector.
(Nergal Heavy Industries... Is this man pulling the strings...? No, he's not.)
I'm aware of the Scaparelli Project.
...But with the Earth Sphere like this, defense alone stretches us thin.
I'd like the Nadesico to come under Londo Bell's command!
Captain, what should we do?
Let's see... We left everything up to them with the Gandor unit,
so let's do our best this time. They're not our enemies, after all!
Personally, I'd rather we bid them farewell as soon as possible...
High heat source approaching at high speed.
A-another enemy!?
Lizards!?
What...!? A Gundam...!?
Impossible. ...But that face design...
Identification...!?
Unidentified... It may be an entirely new model.
But... it's not on Anaheim Electronics' production lines.
Not made by Anaheim...? Are you sure!?
Yes. I did a little hacking.
Hoshino!
Ah, this isn't the sort of thing Nergal does on a regular basis, mind you...
Oh my, she's pretty good, isn't she?
It's still headed for Earth. We're the only ones who can stop it!
Captain Misumaru, the Nadesico is now under Londo Bell's command!
Understood! Okay, Akito, go get 'em!
Why's it always gotta be me...
Quit your whining! Let's go all out! All out!
Before we destroy it, I'd at least like to know where it came from...
Yeah. If that's a Gundam, then at least it's not an alien machine...
That's about all we know.
(I'd like to find the right moment to slip away...
At this rate, we'll never make it to Mars...)
Heat source approaching.
There's more coming!?
Whose side!? Don't tell me it's the Za Boom or the Vega Star Federation!?
They're broadcasting an ID signal... This is...
Kyoooojiiii!!
Is that... another Gundam!?
Are they with that big Gundam!?
The ID signals are registered.
Neo Japan Colony's Shining Gundam, Neo Sweden Colony's Nobel Gundam,
and Neo Hong Kong Colony's Master Gundam.
Outta the way! Let's finish this, Domon!
...Ohhh! This hand of mine is burning red!
(This is... I see... Magnificent...!)
Who are they?
Wow! Could it be... a Gundam Fight!?
That's it...! Mobile Fighters...
Melee mobile suits built for the Gundam Fight!
The Federation! We pursue this one on Ulube's orders! Do not interfere!
Ulube...? Major Ulube Ishikawa? And who are you?
Master Asiaaa!
Hey, Excellen, how do you know him!?
Oh my, I may not look it, but I'm quite the martial arts buff, you know?
If you get in my way, I won't hold back! Stay out of this!
Things suddenly got pretty heated, huh!?
Now's our chance! Minato! Nadesico, maximum battle speed, please!
The Captain hasn't given the order yet, though?
Going to Mars was our goal from the start, so let's go!
Same thing we did to the Gandor unit.
Hey, Yurika!
Good work out there, Akito!
Yamada, please return to the ship too.
I told you, it's Daigouji!
Is it really okay to keep doing stuff like this...?
Hm? Captain, the Nadesico is...
Damn it! Wait, Captain Misumaru!
We've got our own job to do, you see!
I'd prefer a job that didn't cause people so much trouble, though.
Damn it...!
Captain, if we're pursuing, I'll go...!
...We can't afford that...! Forget the Nadesico!
Top priority: wreck the Lizard robots and seize that big Gundam!
(That battleship... did it just escape from Earth?
...No matter. This will only make it easier for me to act.)
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Kyoji! This ends here! ...Why did you steal the Ultimate Gundam!?
Because of you, Father and Mother...!
Heh heh heh... Heh heh... Heh heh heh heh heh...
He's... laughing...?
What's so funny!? Kyo... Ngh!?
Wh-what!?
It regenerated... It repaired itself...!?
What... is going on!? Hm!
Uh-oh!
To Earth!?
Careless of me! Domon!
Damn iiit! Let's go! Master! Allenby!
Yeah! Got it!
A mysterious giant Gundam, and mobile suits for the Gundam Fight...
What could this combination mean...?
...All hands, sweep up the remaining enemy forces.
You sure about this, Captain?
...We're so powerless. All this going on, and this is all we can spare.
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
No enemy readings nearby... Is it over?
Geez, what is going on!?
New enemies scurrying around Earth one after another!
Oh my, Maria, that's no good. Getting hysterical at your age?
But the Nadesico is likely headed to Mars... and those Gundams to Earth...
In the end, we couldn't stop either of them.
...I'll check with each colony about the Gundam Fighters.
...Reinforcing our forces is urgent.
You mean the super robots?
...Yes. We'll hold the enemy in check and hurry to each rendezvous.
